allowances.proof: The advisory needs an attacker-supplied brace pattern. vite-plugin-singlefile is the only package that loads micromatch, and it calls micromatch.isMatch only when its inlinePattern option is non-empty. dashboard/vite.config.ts calls viteSingleFile() without options, so braces never parses a pattern. The plugin runs only during vite build and is not bundled into dist.
allowances.remove_when: scripts/node_audit.py fails once the advisory disappears from the lockfile, its range changes, or npm reports an applicable fix. tests/test_node_audit.py fails once dashboard/vite.config.ts passes options to viteSingleFile().
